name: Queen's Tower

geometryEvidence.note: Subject footprint in inherited OSM geometry; sight line intersects only this tower.

photoSpotReason: Changed by Agent 6 for the demo (15 Nov 2026): Imperial College Road beside the Central Library, looking west at the tower, so the reference photo and the period scenes show the same street. Estimated, not checked on site.

referencePhoto.notes: Looking west up Imperial College Road (the old Imperial Institute Road) past the Central Library to the Queen’s Tower. Replaces the padded 2014 stand-in, which the scene model kept zooming out of. Replace with the team H1 photo when it arrives.

eraYearsReason.1893: Formal opening on 10 May 1893; period images document the connected frontage.
